review.why: Entry card for an HTML weekly-report deck; the real authoring rules sit in a master skill not included.
review.summary: Short entry point to a weekly-report slide template: copy the template files, fix the parent-relative asset paths (copy or inline them), pick a theme, replace the demo content and keep speaker notes out of the slide. Everything else is delegated to a master html-ppt skill and a template folder.
strengths: Explains exactly how to fix the broken relative asset paths
Rule: speaker notes never appear as visible slide text
cautions: Depends on a master skill and template folder that are not part of this skill
The example prompt is about one product's growth metrics
Metadata is bilingual and cluttered with tags
